title: The Guerrilla-War-of-the-Mind Strategy: Do Not Fight the Last War
coreMove: Separate what the present situation is showing from the old victory your memory wants to replay.
sourcePressure: Previous success becomes a liability when conditions change and the mind reaches for the last war instead of the current one.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Worship novelty or throw away useful experience just because the labels changed.

hook: Do not open with a battlefield metaphor for The Guerrilla-War-of-the-Mind Strategy: Do Not Fight the Last War.
Do not start by saying strategy is not about violence.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable correction frame that the move is not X but Y.
Avoid a bland paradox about strength looking like weakness.
tryThisNow: No generic timer, pause, breathe, or list-three-options prompt.
No reusable ask what matters most prompt.
examples: No generic founder in a pitch deck unless the domain requires it.
No battlefield reenactment or invented historical anecdote.
